market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver currently trades near $32/oz, making a rise to $120 a 275% gain in ~14 months. This would require a move far beyond the all-time high of ~$50, an event with extremely low probability given typical volatility and fundamental constraints. I assign a 1% chance, far below the market-implied 6.7%.
evidence_points: Silver spot ~$32 in April 2025, all-time high ~$50 (1980/2011).
Only 14 months remain until expiry – extremely short window for a >3x rally.
CME settlement-based trigger requires an official daily close at/above $120, which has never occurred.
sources_consulted: Current market conditions as of April 2025
